title: Stepson not eligible for family pension under Railway Pension Rules: Madras High Court
description: The Madras High Court has held that a stepson is not eligible to receive family pension under the Railway Services (Pension) Rules, 1993 [Union of India Vs Registrar].A Bench of Justices SM Subramaniam and N Senthilkumar set aside an order passed by the Central Administrative Tribunal which had granted family pension to the stepson of a deceased Southern Railway employee."Under the Railway Services (Pension) Rules, 1993, a Government servant may nominate any person for receiving gratuity.
